grid.ts
// a million rows, one call
import { ZenGrid } from '@zengrid/core'

const grid = new ZenGrid(el, {
  data: rows,
  columns,
  virtual: true,
  sortable: true,
  editable: true,
})
Typed end to end
Columns, editors, events, and plugins are all typed APIs — your IDE knows your grid.
Spreadsheet muscle
Selection, clipboard, keyboard nav, inline editing, multi-sort, and deep filtering built in.
Backend-ready
Load rows on demand with backend hooks — infinite scroll without holding it all in memory.
